```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = normalizePath(params$root, mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(params$root, "R", "00_paths.R"))
activate_local_lib()
source_vc("05_report_helpers.R")
library(dplyr)
profile <- params$profile
runtime <- read_validation_table("validation_runtime_projection", profile)
diagnostics <- read_validation_table("validation_diagnostics", profile)
```

# Runtime Projection

```{r}
kable_if_rows(compact_columns(runtime, c(
  "profile", "job_type", "observed_jobs", "successful_jobs",
  "median_runtime_sec", "p90_runtime_sec",
  "production_jobs", "projected_core_hours",
  "projected_wall_hours_8_workers"
)), "Runtime projection")
```

# Slowest Jobs

```{r}
slow <- diagnostics |>
  arrange(desc(runtime_sec)) |>
  select(job_id, fit_success, runtime_sec, n_boot_requested,
         boot_success_rate, lambda_path_length, selected_lambda,
         selected_lambda_at_path_boundary, all_zero_exposure) |>
  head(20)
kable_if_rows(slow, "Slowest jobs")
```
